topThreats.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
topThreats.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild. [...]
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep for exposed interfaces. Task Execution: Apply vendor patch or emergency WAF virtual patch, audit access logs for IOCs, and restrict management ports.

topThreats.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
topThreats.summary: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin. topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Validate NIST CSF 2.0 / NERC CIP / 10 CFR 73.54 boundary isolation. Task Execution: Enforce unidirectional or zero-trust Purdue Model conduits, rotate boundary credentials, and monitor engineering workstation logs.
